kevin: morning, quick async standup — cross-shard warmup check
kevin: what I did: ran end-to-end microbench for cross-shard prefix caching; added slot rebalancer logs; pushed PR #4123 (warmup + metrics)
kevin: blockers: env var for selective priming isn't working on canary (warmup fails on 2/8 shards); need someone to eyeball logs
kevin: today: triage canary, figure out why LRU evict triggers during warmup, and split benchmark to isolate batch-size effect

anya: saw the failing run, grabbing logs now. initial hunch: slot ownership handshake times out under high concurrency
anya: can you dump the failing shard's kernel args? also pinging @maria for the rebalancer config

maria: thanks @anya, will check rebalancer rules. FYI I tweaked max_inflight from 200->240 in qa last night
maria: quick note: the new batching heuristic seems to reduce tail by ~5ms in local small runs

sam: re: PR #4123 — left a tiny comment on the metrics naming, otherwise LGTM. can we add a smoke test that runs on circle for 5s? :thumbsup:

kevin: adding smoke test now, will push update. snippet I used to repro locally:
```
python tools/bench.py --model gpt-j --shards 8 --batch-size 4 --warmup 100
```
